items.title: The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the five project phases (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke neeche sirf ek figure deti hai jis mein project management plan ki paanch phases hain:

blocks.alt: Paanch rangeen dabbe ek qataar mein, Initiation, Planning, Execution, Performance monitoring aur Project closure, ek timeline ke oopar hain jis par 1 se 5 tak number wale nuqte hain. Har nuqte ke neeche ek card par nishan hai: bulb, checklist wala laptop, rocket, doorbeen (binoculars) aur party popper.
blocks.caption: Project management plan ke 5 marahil (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Figure sirf phases ke naam deti hai. Aam taur par in ka matlab yeh hota hai:

items: Initiation (aaghaz): project ka khayal saaf kiya jata hai aur manzoori milti hai.
Planning: kaam, log, timelines aur kharche tay kiye jate hain.
Execution (amal): team kaam karti hai aur product banati hai.
Performance monitoring (nigrani): progress, kharche aur quality ko plan se mila kar dekha jata hai.
Project closure (ikhtitam): mukammal product hawale kar ke project band kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kis phase mein progress, kharche aur quality ko plan se mila kar dekha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Performance monitoring, chauthi phase; yeh execution ke dauran aur project closure se pehle hoti hai.

items: Paanch phases: initiation, planning, execution, performance monitoring, project closure.
